    ( Str == "" -> true

      ( Parts = [AStr, BStr | _] ->

          number_string(B, BStr),
          gcd(A, B, G),
          L is (A // G) * B,
          format("~w~n~w~n", [G, L])
      ; true
      )
    ).

gcd(A, B, G) :-
    ( B =:= 0 -> G = A
    ; R is A mod B,
      gcd(B, R, G)
    ).
